exposure: Kinesiologic tape applied to the region of spinal nerves T10-L1 and S2-S4
Kinesiologic tape applied to the region of spinal nerves T1-T4 (control)
outcome: Maternal satisfaction with delivery and tape use
cohort: Low-risk pregnant women with spontaneous onset of labor and no previous Cesarean section.
finding: While safe, applying kinesiologic tape to the region of spinal nerves T10-L1 and S2-S4 during labor did not effectively control labor pain compared to the control group.
